answer_1.quote: Referring expression generation (REG) aims at generating utterances that help anchoring an object within an image.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation we opt for automatic metrics. Specifically, in order to measure the naturalness of referring expressions we use the standard automatic metrics that have been used in REG that compare the generated referring expression with the human ones: BLEU, CIDEr and METEOR. In order to evaluate the diversity, we report: (1) the average length of referring expressions (ASL) (2) the number of unique words of the generated corpus; (Voc) and (3) the average number of unique bigrams per 1000 bigrams (TTR).
